'''R2-W3''' an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] owned by the company [[Renna's Transport Service]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], R2-W3 was assigned to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Second Breath]]'' on an assignment to ferry a cargo of explosives from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to a [[Amir D'Vail|buyer]] on the world of [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]].

==Biography==
R2-W3 was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="Outward Bound" /> built by the manufacturer [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Outward Bound" /> as part of the [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] line. R2-W3 came to work for [[Renna's Transport Service]], a transportation company operated by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] entrepreneur [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]] from at warehouse compound in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Outward Bound" />

{{RPG|[[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']]}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Renna hired a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to transport a cargo of [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]]-made explosives to a [[Amir D'Vail|buyer]] on the world of [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]]<ref name="Outward Bound" /> in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Renna provided the operatives with the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Second Breath]]'' for the errand and assigned R2-W3 to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="Outward Bound" />

With R2-W3 at the helm, the ''Second Breath'' departed Cularin and traveled for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] through the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] until reaching the [[Cularin comet cloud]], the point in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] from which it became safe to enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The R2 unit then engaged the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and flew the vessel to the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]], exiting from hyperspace into the midst of a a high-speed chase between the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Dessin's Dagger]]'' and three Republic [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. At the last moment, R2-W3 swerved the ''Second Breath'' away and avoided a collision with ''Dessin's Dagger''. On the orders of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic forces]], the R2 unit docked the ''Second Breath'' at [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] [[Besh/Legends|Besh]]-9 of ''[[New Dawn (space station)|New Dawn]]'', a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used as a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] base, so that the freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] could explain their presence in Druckenwell to [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Republic forces in the system, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Renij Jaa]].<ref name="Outward Bound" />

Once satisfied, Jaa allowed the agents to leave and R2-W3 landed in [[docking bay 1138]] in the city [[Taggon]] to deposit their cargo. Afterward, R2-W3 piloted the ''Second Breath'' back to the Cularin system with the freelance agents.<ref name="Outward Bound" />
{{Endgame}}

==Characteristics==
[[File:RennasTransportService-ShadowsInGreen.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Renna's Transport Service logo]]
R2-W3 was a mercurial and loquacious droid who was prone to sarcasm. As a consequence of some fragile [[Logic circuit/Legends|logic circuits]], it was easily riled and regarded [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as inconstant, disobliging beings who always wanted tasks to be completed quickly, in unreasonable timeframes. When working at Renna's Transport Service, it provided its services in an obedient but sneering manner and was open about its dissatisfaction when it felt imposed upon.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

The astromech droid was a proficient starship pilot and experienced in [[Astrogation/Legends|astronavigation]] and the use of [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. It was familiar with multiple [[Language/Legends|languages]] and in addition to being able to speak [[Binary/Legends|Binary]], it understood [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], [[Durese/Legends|Duros]], [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'lek]].<ref name="Outward Bound" />

The R2 unit had [[Color/Legends|navy blue]] plating and enamelled on one leg it bore the logo of Renna's Transport Service. Its components included an [[improved sensor package]], a [[Diagnostic scanner/Legends|diagnostics package]], a [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processor]] and a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] unit. The droid also had [[Infrared receptor|infrared vision]] and was equipped with a [[Telescope/Legends|telescopic]] appendage, an [[Arc welder/Legends|arc welder]], [[magnetic feet]], a [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguisher]] and four tool mounts. Additionally, R2-W3 possessed 2 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of internal storage.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-W3 featured in the [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]], which formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. In the adventure, player characters roleplay as the operatives hired by Renna to transport the cargo of explosives to Druckenwell. The players have a choice of either ferrying the goods in their own vessel or in the ''Second Breath''; if the players choose the latter option and none of them possess starship operation skills, Renna assigns R2-W3 to accompany them on the trip as their pilot.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

If R2-W3 joins the player characters in their journey, on arrival in the Druckenwell system the players have the option to have the ''Second Breath'' aid the Republic forces in pursuit of ''Dessin's Dagger''. If the players choose to assist the Republic starfighters, R2-W3 does not volunteer to give chase to ''Dessin's Dagger'' but can be ordered to do so by the player characters. As an alternative to going after ''Dessin's Dagger'', the freelance agents can choose to aid the stricken civilian freighter ''[[Third Time Lucky]]'' that has whirled dangerously out of control. If the player characters order R2-W3 to attempt to have the ''Second Breath'' nudge the ''Third Time Lucky'' to slow the freighter's spin, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] is not able to complete the maneuver.<ref name="Outward Bound" />
